acceptance.given: Pinned replay inputs have identity and evidence relationships that have not yet been re-established by fresh replay.

oracle.expected: Fresh replay receipts demonstrate equality of the required target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, and evidence bindings.
forbidden: Copied, stale, mismatched, or unattributed evidence is accepted as reproduction.
Required identity or evidence bindings are omitted while the semantic result is accepted.
oracle.observable: Fresh replay receipts and their reconstructed identity and evidence bindings.

acceptance.then: Required identity and evidence relationships are verified for the reproduced semantic result.
acceptance.when: Fresh replay evidence is evaluated for semantic reproduction.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the fresh-replay selector with a changed target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, or evidence binding.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconstruct the original binding identity before fresh replay, replay with that same identity, and reject changed, omitted, stale, copied, or unattributed target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, or evidence bindings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing receipt and terminal-verdict compatibility is preserved; unequal or missing bound identity/evidence relationships invalidate semantic reproduction.

slice_hint.state_transition: Pinned identity and evidence relationships not yet re-established to fresh replay receipt verifying every required relationship.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Fresh replay first rebuilds the original binding identity, replays with that same identity, and rejects an identity mismatch or omitted, stale, copied, or unattributed evidence binding.

oracle.expected: New repair evidence, if recorded, follows and preserves all pre-existing repair evidence.
oracle.observable: The repair-evidence artifact before and after recording, evaluated for append-only preservation.

acceptance.then: Existing repair evidence is retained and any new repair evidence is appended.
acceptance.when: Repair-evidence recording is evaluated by the append-only preservation selector.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the append-only preservation selector with an overwritten, deleted, or rewritten historical repair-evidence segment.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure repair-evidence recording preserves existing bytes and appends any new repair evidence after them.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Historical repair-evidence bytes remain immutable; appended evidence preserves the existing evidence format and non-authorizing status.

slice_hint.state_transition: Existing repair evidence to existing evidence retained with any new repair evidence appended.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The append-only selector proves that recording new repair evidence preserves every pre-existing repair-evidence segment unchanged.

acceptance.given: An invalid-package adversarial case is supplied to the Toolchain success evaluator.

oracle.expected: Evaluation returns a non-success outcome for the invalid-package case.
forbidden: The invalid-package case is classified as success.
A stale or unrelated receipt is used instead of executing the invalid-package evaluation.
oracle.observable: The evaluator's current result contains a non-success verdict tied to the invalid-package input.

acceptance.then: The invalid-package case is rejected as success and produces a current non-success verdict.
acceptance.when: When an invalid-package case is evaluated by the Toolchain replay/evaluation path.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure invalid-package inputs cannot yield a success verdict; emit a current non-success evaluation result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing replay result schema and verdict compatibility; revert only invalid-package success handling and its S24 test.

slice_hint.state_transition: Invalid-package evaluation moves from success-accepted to explicit non-success rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A live invalid-package evaluation produces non-success and the success path is not taken.

acceptance.given: An obligation graph contains Atomic Obligation-to-witness links for exact-cover validation.

oracle.expected: The structural exact-cover report establishes both forward Atomic Obligation coverage and reverse witness coverage without orphan witness links.
forbidden: An Atomic Obligation is covered by witnesses without reverse coverage.
A witness node is linked without corresponding Atomic Obligation coverage.
oracle.observable: The S20 exact-cover validator report and its assertions for the Atomic Obligation-to-witness relation.

acceptance.then: Every Atomic Obligation and its witness coverage are mutually and exactly covered.
acceptance.when: The planned S20 test invokes exact-cover validation during obligation-graph compilation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The S20 test must fail when forward Atomic Obligation coverage lacks matching reverse witness coverage or a witness link is orphaned.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate the Atomic Obligation-to-witness relation as bidirectional Exact Cover, rejecting missing reverse coverage and orphan witness nodes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores the prior Toolchain conformance behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unverified Atomic Obligation-to-witness relation transitions to a structurally verified bidirectional Exact Cover relation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S20 exact-cover check reports forward and reverse coverage for every Atomic Obligation-to-witness relationship and no orphan witness node.
